title: Add "close others" option to close all but the most recently active window in an application
line: Right-clicking an app with several open windows in the Task Manager now offers "Close All Except Last Used".
explanation: The Task Manager context menu of a grouped app only offered "Close All", so keeping just one window meant closing the others one by one. The wish asks for Cinnamon's "Close others". The change adds "Close All Except Last Used" below "Close All" for grouped tasks; it picks the child window with the newest LastActivated time from the tasks model and asks every other window to close.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: add "Close All Except Last Used" to grouped tasks

With several windows of the same app grouped together, the only way to
reduce clutter was closing them one by one. Grouped tasks now also offer
an action that closes all of their windows but the most recently used.

BUG: 524331

media.caption: Three Konsole windows grouped: the menu only has Close All
Same group: the menu now also has Close All Except Last Used
Windows One, Two, Three open; Two was used last
After the new action (second run with Two, Alpha, Beta, Two used last after Alpha): only Two is left

review.text: Adding "Close All Except Last Used" below "Close All" for grouped tasks in ContextMenu.qml is clean UX and directly fulfills the wishlist. However, the LastActivated timestamp comparison has a subtle JavaScript Invalid Date/NaN bug: in QML, an invalid QDateTime (for a window never activated since plasmashell started) converts to a truthy Invalid Date whose .getTime() is NaN. If row 0 was never activated, lastUsedTime becomes NaN and every subsequent time > NaN evaluates to false, keeping the never-activated window and closing the actually most recently used one.
changes: Guard against Invalid Date / NaN from AbstractTasksModel.LastActivated (e.g. compute rawTime = lastActivated ? lastActivated.getTime() : NaN and use Number.isNaN(rawTime) ? -Infinity : rawTime) so never-activated windows truly count as oldest.
Hide tasks.groupDialog when tasks.groupDialog !== null && tasks.groupDialog.visualParent === menu.visualParent (matching closeWindowItem's onClicked).
Verify the never-activated-window-in-row-0 case (e.g. after restarting plasmashell or opening a window without activating it) before merging.

reviews.text: This does exactly what the wish asks: on a grouped task icon, a new item below Close All closes every child window except the one with the newest LastActivated, using the existing foreachChildTask helper and requestClose (asynchronous, so the rows stay stable during the loop). Its visibility and enabled state follow Close All, so single windows, launchers and startups are unaffected, and the label explains itself on a group icon where 'Close Others' would have no reference window. The two runs show the right window kept, including when the last-used window is the oldest. Small nit: unlike Close All, it doesn't hide an open group dialog for the same task, which is harmless since one window stays.
